header.title: About us
header.description: We are a company dedicated to simplifying your logistics, automotive, and mining needs.

whoSection.title: Who are we?
whoSection.paragraph1: We are a key player in the resources sector, operating across multiple regions and distributing products worldwide.
whoSection.paragraph2: Our strategy is based on key trends shaping the future. We supply essential minerals to industry, such as lithium and coltan.
whoSection.paragraph3: A resource portfolio designed to meet today’s needs and tomorrow’s challenges.

stat2.desc: Client satisfaction is at the heart of our priorities.

strategySection.title: Our strategy
strategySection.description: We responsibly manage a diversified and resilient portfolio of assets in strategic and promising sectors. We create value by excelling in operations, discovering and developing new resources, acquiring the right assets, and optimizing our investments. Through our unique approach to social value creation, we are a trusted partner delivering benefits to all stakeholders.

valuesSection.title: Our values
valuesSection.description:
Doing what is right:
Our commitment to a sustainable future begins with safety, integrity, and building trust with all our partners.
Seeking better ways:
Active listening and innovation help us tackle challenges and constantly move forward.
Making an impact:
Every day, we take responsibility for our actions, value creation, and the positive impact we can generate.

quoteSection.text: At Fidex, we simplify logistics, facilitate the buying and selling of vehicles, and provide essential resources. Our services meet daily needs while supporting economic development and promoting sustainable solutions for the future.

officeSection.title: We welcome you to our offices
officeSection.description: At Fidex Distribution, we pride ourselves on offering our employees a modern, functional, and pleasant work environment. Located in the heart of Kinshasa, our offices are designed to foster collaboration, focus, and daily well-being.
